# Michael Siddi

> Mobile Development Manager at Smile.CX, based in Turin, Italy. 15+ years building iOS and Android apps and mobile SDKs, with apps ranked #1 on the App Store and Google Play.

Born in Sardinia, based in Turin, splitting time between Turin and Cagliari. Currently leading a team building a new app that combines communication and customer care tools with AI at its core.

## Experience

- Smile.CX: Mobile Development Manager (current)
- CoderStreet: CTO & Co-Founder
- ShopFully: Mobile Architect
- Vivocha: Lead Mobile Developer
- Tiscali: iOS Developer

## Projects

- [Lunette](https://www.lunetteapp.com): iOS app for watch collectors. Catalog timepieces, track wear and timing accuracy, log service history.
- [PoettoApp](https://www.lanuovasardegna.it/cagliari/cronaca/2015/08/06/news/cagliari-poetto-app-tutto-sulla-spiaggia-dei-centomila-1.11894507): app for Poetto beach in Cagliari (archived).
